prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a wide 16:9 static background painting for a desktop frozen-palace adventure game, not a UI mockup. Input image 1 is ONLY a visual style and camera reference; generate a new empty single-room background. Primary request: the interior of ONE tall palace ballroom seen from its entrance, close enough that it feels like a room the player stands in, not a dollhouse palace, castle exterior, world map or panoramic connected levels. Keep the reference's beautifully painted silver-white stone, teal shadows, frosted architectural surfaces, restrained antique gold, rich depth and cinematic polished fantasy game illustration. Camera: elevated three-quarter view from the entrance, floor spreading toward rear columns. Empty spacious central/lower floor for independent traveler and observation overlays; tall carved wall columns and cold pale windows at the sides, subtle weathered patterns. Ceiling cropped above frame. Light is diffuse cool daylight, not candles. Entire scene within one ballroom, no view into other rooms. Do not paint a chandelier: it will be a separate existing object sprite gated by actual player information. No people, creatures, player, NPCs, body silhouettes, statues shaped like people, tokens, treasure, furniture, text, symbols, UI, buttons, map, labels, numbers, visible flames, candles, torches, doorways, staircases, quest markers or additional passageways. Floor ornament must be abstract architectural texture, no magic glyph or ritual circle. Balanced detailed room composition, clear open lower-center floor, highest quality painterly game background. Nontransparent full image.

Input image is camera, palette and painterly style reference only. One ordinary adult traveler in a plain burgundy cloak, modest dark tunic and worn boots, viewed from behind in three-quarter perspective, facing toward upper right. Face turned away, no identity requirements. Standing steady, full body and boots inside frame with generous transparent padding. Right forearm raised slightly with a gloved hand in a loose grip: do not paint any held object or light, we add the game's Everflame symbol as an independent UI layer. Detailed elegant hand-painted game art, cool silver-blue rim light, soft folds of burgundy cloth, restrained earth colors, sharp readable silhouette.
